1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate
3	  A rate integrated since a condition last became true, over the whole trace in one forward pass,
4	  and its specification over Lean's `Rat`.
5	
6	  The start at observation `i` is `Temporal.runStartAll`'s: the latest observation `j ≤ i` at which
7	  the condition rose definitely (false at `j − 1`, true at `j`), with the condition known at every
8	  observation of `(j, i]`. The value is Σ_{k ∈ (j, i]} rate_k · (t_k − t_{k−1}): zero at the start,
9	  the rate at an observation covering the interval that ends there. It is unknown, never a value,
10	  at every observation when the step bound is not positive; where the start is unknown or none is
11	  observed (`windowTruncated op`, or the condition's reason); where an interval ending at an
12	  observation of `[j, i]`, the one ending at the start included, is longer than the step bound
13	  (`samplingGap op`); where a rate of `(j, i]` is missing (`missing`).
14	
15	  Proved here: the start is exactly the latest definite rise with the condition known since; a
16	  decided value comes from such a start, a positive bound, intervals within the bound, present rates,
17	  and equals the discrete sum; each unknown case gives its reason; the value at `i` depends only on
18	  the inputs at observations `≤ i`; the sum splits at any intermediate observation.
19	-/
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
21	
22	namespace TrafficSpec
23	
24	/-- A rational's value in Lean's `Rat`. -/
25	def Q.val (q : Q) : Rat := mkRat q.num q.den
26	
27	namespace Accumulate
28	open Temporal
29	
30	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
31	-- The operator
32	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
33	/-- The running state at an observation: the sum of rate × interval since the trace start (a
34	    missing rate adds nothing), the latest observation whose rate is missing, and the latest
35	    observation reached across an interval longer than the step bound. -/
36	structure Run where
37	  sum : Q
38	  lastMissing : Option Nat
39	  lastWide : Option Nat
40	  deriving Inhabited
41	
42	def Run.init : Run := ⟨Q.zero, none, none⟩
43	
44	/-- The interval ending at observation `i`; zero at the first. -/
45	def dt (times : Array Q) (i : Nat) : Q := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub times[i]! times[i - 1]!
46	
47	/-- The state at observation `i` from the state at the observation before. -/
48	def runStep (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) (prev : Run) (i : Nat) : Run :=
49	  { sum := match rate[i]! with | some ω => Q.add prev.sum (Q.mul ω (dt times i)) | none => prev.sum
50	    lastMissing := if (rate[i]!).isNone then some i else prev.lastMissing
51	    lastWide := if i != 0 && Q.gt (dt times i) maxStep then some i else prev.lastWide }
52	
53	/-- The state at each of the first `n` observations, in one forward pass. -/
54	def runs (n : Nat) (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) : Array Run :=
55	  (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Run) i =>
56	    acc.push (runStep times rate maxStep (if i = 0 then Run.init else acc[i - 1]!) i)) #[]
57	
58	/-- The value at `i` from the starts and the states. -/
59	def valueAt (starts : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat))) (rs : Array Run) (op : String)
60	    (missing : UnknownReason) (i : Nat) : QR :=
61	  match starts[i]! with
62	  | .error e => .error e
63	  | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
64	  | .ok (some j) =>
65	    if (rs[i]!).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) then .error (.samplingGap op)
66	    else if (rs[i]!).lastMissing.any (j < ·) then .error missing
67	    else .ok (Q.sub (rs[i]!).sum (rs[j]!).sum)
68	
69	/-- Rate × interval accumulated since ψ last became true, per observation. -/
70	def sinceRiseIntegralAll (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) (op : String)
71	    (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ : Array R) : Array QR :=
72	  if Q.lt Q.zero maxStep then
73	    (Array.range ψ.size).map (valueAt (runStartAll op ψ) (runs ψ.size times rate maxStep) op missing)
74	  else Array.replicate ψ.size (.error (.malformed s!"{op} step bound is not positive"))
75	
76	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
77	-- The specification
78	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
79	/-- Σ_{k ∈ (j, i]} rate_k · (t_k − t_{k−1}) over `Rat`; none where a rate of `(j, i]` is missing;
80	    zero where `i ≤ j`. -/
81	def integral (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (j : Nat) : Nat → Option Rat
82	  | 0 => some 0
83	  | i + 1 => if i + 1 ≤ j then some 0 else do
84	      let acc ← integral times rate j i
85	      let ω ← rate[i + 1]!
86	      pure (acc + ω.val * ((times[i + 1]!).val - (times[i]!).val))
87	
88	/-- ψ rises definitely at `j`: false at the observation before, true there. -/
89	def RisesAt (ψ : Array R) (j : Nat) : Prop := 0 < j ∧ ψ[j - 1]!.v = .f ∧ ψ[j]!.v = .t
90	
91	/-- `j` is the start at `i`: a definite rise at `j ≤ i`, ψ known and rising nowhere in `(j, i]`. -/
92	def AnchorAt (ψ : Array R) (j i : Nat) : Prop :=
93	  j ≤ i ∧ RisesAt ψ j ∧ ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k
94	
95	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
96	-- `Q` in `Rat`
97	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
98	section QVal
99	
100	private theorem Q.ext' {a b : Q} (h₁ : a.num = b.num) (h₂ : a.den = b.den) : a = b := by
101	  cases a; cases b; simp_all
102	
103	theorem Q.val_mk' (a : Int) (b : Nat) (hb : 0 < b) : (Q.mk' a b).val = mkRat a b := by
104	  unfold Q.mk' Q.val
105	  rw [dif_pos hb]
106	  simp only
107	  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd a.natAbs b := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ hb
108	  have ha : ((Nat.gcd a.natAbs b : Nat) : Int) ∣ a := Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
109	  have hbd : Nat.gcd a.natAbs b ∣ b := Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
110	  generalize Nat.gcd a.natAbs b = G at hg ha hbd ⊢
111	  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := ha
112	  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hbd
113	  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by omega), Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg, Rat.mkRat_mul_left (Nat.ne_of_gt hg)]
114	
115	private theorem den_ne (q : Q) : q.den ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt q.den_pos
116	
117	theorem Q.val_add (a b : Q) : (Q.add a b).val = a.val + b.val := by
118	  unfold Q.add
119	  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
120	  unfold Q.val
121	  rw [Rat.mkRat_add_mkRat _ _ (den_ne a) (den_ne b)]
122	
123	theorem Q.val_mul (a b : Q) : (Q.mul a b).val = a.val * b.val := by
124	  unfold Q.mul
125	  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
126	  unfold Q.val
127	  rw [Rat.mkRat_mul_mkRat]
128	
129	theorem Q.val_sub (a b : Q) : (Q.sub a b).val = a.val - b.val := by
130	  unfold Q.sub
131	  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
132	  unfold Q.val
133	  rw [Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, Rat.neg_mkRat, Rat.mkRat_add_mkRat _ _ (den_ne a) (den_ne b), Int.neg_mul,
134	    ← Int.sub_eq_add_neg]
135	
136	theorem Q.eq_iff_val (a b : Q) : Q.eq a b = true ↔ a.val = b.val := by
137	  unfold Q.eq Q.val
138	  rw [Rat.mkRat_eq_iff (den_ne a) (den_ne b)]
139	  simp
140	
141	theorem Q.sub_self (a : Q) : Q.sub a a = Q.zero := by
142	  unfold Q.sub Q.mk'
143	  have hp : a.den * a.den > 0 := Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos a.den_pos
144	  rw [dif_pos hp]
145	  apply Q.ext' <;> simp [Q.zero, Q.ofInt, Int.sub_self, Nat.div_self hp]
146	
147	theorem Q.le_iff_not_gt (a b : Q) : Q.le a b = true ↔ Q.gt a b = false := by
148	  unfold Q.le Q.gt Q.lt
149	  simp [Int.not_lt]
150	
151	end QVal
152	
153	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
154	-- The passes, by observation
155	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
156	section Passes
157	variable (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (g : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
158	
159	/-- One step of `runStartAll`, as its forward pass computes it. -/
160	def startStep (vals : Array R) (prev : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) (i : Nat) :
161	    Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
162	  match vals[i]!.v with
163	  | .t =>
164	    if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
165	    else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
166	      | .t => prev
167	      | .f => .ok (some i)
168	      | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
169	  | .f => prev
170	  | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
171	
172	/-- The state of `runStartAll` at observation `i`. -/
173	def startAt (vals : Array R) : Nat → Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)
174	  | 0 => startStep op vals (.ok none) 0
175	  | i + 1 => startStep op vals (startAt vals i) (i + 1)
176	
177	/-- The running state at observation `i`. -/
178	def runAt : Nat → Run
179	  | 0 => runStep times rate g Run.init 0
180	  | i + 1 => runStep times rate g (runAt i) (i + 1)
181	
182	/-- An array built by pushing, one observation at a time, a value that depends only on the values
183	    already pushed: its size, and each element as `v` gives it. -/
184	theorem build_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Array α → Nat → α) (v : Nat → α) (N : Nat)
185	    (hf : ∀ acc i, i < N → acc.size = i → (∀ m, m < i → acc[m]! = v m) → f acc i = v i) :
186	    ∀ n, n ≤ N → ((List.range n).foldl (fun acc i => acc.push (f acc i)) #[]).size = n ∧
187	      ∀ k, k < n → ((List.range n).foldl (fun acc i => acc.push (f acc i)) #[])[k]! = v k := by
188	  intro n hn
189	  induction n with
190	  | zero => simp
191	  | succ n ih =>
192	    obtain ⟨hs, hk⟩ := ih (by omega)
193	    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]
194	    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
195	    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun k hk' => ?_⟩
196	    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hk' with h | h
197	    · rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hs]; omega), Array.getElem_push_lt (by omega), ← getElem!_pos _ _ (by omega)]
198	      exact hk k h
199	    · subst h
200	      rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hs]), Array.getElem_push]
201	      simp only [hs, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false]
202	      exact hf _ _ (by omega) hs hk
203	
204	theorem runs_get (n i : Nat) (hi : i < n) : (runs n times rate g)[i]! = runAt times rate g i := by
205	  unfold runs
206	  refine (build_get _ (runAt times rate g) n ?_ n (Nat.le_refl _)).2 i hi
207	  intro acc k _ hs hm
208	  cases k with
209	  | zero => rfl
210	  | succ k => simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]; rw [hm k (by omega)]; rfl
211	
212	/-- A forward pass whose state is pushed at each observation, one value at a time: its size and each
213	    element as `v` gives it. -/
214	theorem pairs_get {β : Type} [Inhabited β] (s : β → Nat → β) (init : β) (v : Nat → β)
215	    (h0 : s init 0 = v 0) (hs : ∀ m, s (v m) (m + 1) = v (m + 1)) : ∀ n,
216	    ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).1.size = n ∧
217	    (∀ k, k < n → ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).1[k]! = v k) ∧
218	    (∀ m, n = m + 1 → ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).2 = v m) := by
219	  intro n
220	  induction n with
221	  | zero => simp
222	  | succ n ih =>
223	    obtain ⟨hsz, hk, h2⟩ := ih
224	    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]
225	    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
226	    have hst : s ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).2 n = v n := by
227	      cases n with
228	      | zero => simpa using h0
229	      | succ m => rw [h2 m rfl]; exact hs m
230	    refine ⟨by simp [hsz], fun k hk' => ?_, fun m hm => by cases hm; exact hst⟩
231	    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hk' with h | h
232	    · rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hsz]; omega), Array.getElem_push_lt (by omega), ← getElem!_pos _ _ (by omega)]
233	      exact hk k h
234	    · subst h
235	      rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hsz]), Array.getElem_push]
236	      simp only [hsz, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false]
237	      exact hst
238	
239	theorem runStartAll_get (vals : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < vals.size) :
240	    (runStartAll op vals)[i]! = startAt op vals i := by
241	  unfold runStartAll
242	  dsimp only
243	  rw [Array.mkEmpty_eq]
244	  exact (pairs_get (startStep op vals) (.ok none) (startAt op vals) rfl (fun _ => rfl) vals.size).2.1 i hi
245	
246	end Passes
247	
248	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
249	-- The start
250	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
251	section Start
252	variable {op : String} {ψ : Array R}
253	
254	theorem AnchorAt.mono {j i i' : Nat} (h : AnchorAt ψ j i') (hji : j ≤ i) (hii : i ≤ i') : AnchorAt ψ j i :=
255	  ⟨hji, h.2.1, fun k h1 h2 => h.2.2 k h1 (Nat.le_trans h2 hii)⟩
256	
257	/-- T2: the start is `j` exactly where `j` is the latest definite rise with ψ known since. -/
258	theorem startAt_some_iff (i j : Nat) : startAt op ψ i = .ok (some j) ↔ AnchorAt ψ j i := by
259	  constructor
260	  · intro h

262	    | zero =>
263	      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
264	      cases hv : ψ[0]!.v <;> simp [hv] at h

271	          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk2) with hk | hk
272	          · exact h3 k hk1 (by omega)
273	          · subst hk; refine ⟨by simp [hv], fun ⟨_, hf, _⟩ => ?_⟩

275	        · cases h
276	          exact ⟨Nat.le_refl _, ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩, fun k h1 h2 => absurd h2 (by omega)⟩

309	        simp [hf]
310	
311	/-- T3: no start observed exactly where ψ has been false at every observation so far. -/
312	theorem startAt_none_iff (i : Nat) : startAt op ψ i = .ok none ↔ ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v = .f := by
313	  constructor
314	  · intro h
315	    induction i with
316	    | zero =>
317	      intro k hk; have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
318	      subst hk0
319	      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
320	      cases hv : ψ[0]!.v <;> simp [hv] at h ⊢
321	    | succ i ih =>
322	      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
323	      cases hv : ψ[i + 1]!.v <;> simp only [hv, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
324	      · cases hp : ψ[i]!.v <;> simp only [hp] at h
325	        · have := ih h i (Nat.le_refl _); rw [hp] at this; cases this
326	        · cases h
327	        · cases h
328	      · intro k hk
329	        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk) with hk' | hk'
330	        · exact ih h k (by omega)
331	        · subst hk'; exact hv
332	      · cases h
333	  · intro h
334	    induction i with
335	    | zero => simp [startAt, startStep, h 0 (Nat.le_refl _)]
336	    | succ i ih =>
337	      simp only [startAt, startStep, h (i + 1) (Nat.le_refl _)]
338	      exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by omega))
339	
340	/-- A run of true values reaching the first observation, with ψ known and rising nowhere since,
341	    leaves the start truncated: the onset may lie before the recording. -/
342	theorem startAt_truncated (i : Nat) (h0 : ψ[0]!.v = .t)
343	    (h : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k) :
344	    startAt op ψ i = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
345	  induction i with
346	  | zero => simp [startAt, startStep, h0]
347	  | succ m ih =>
348	    have ih' := ih (fun k h1 h2 => h k h1 (by omega))
349	    obtain ⟨hu, hnr⟩ := h (m + 1) (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
350	    simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
351	    cases hv : ψ[m + 1]!.v with
352	    | u => exact absurd hv hu
353	    | f => exact ih'
354	    | t =>
355	      have hp : ψ[m]!.v = .t := by
356	        cases hp : ψ[m]!.v with
357	        | t => rfl
358	        | f => exact absurd ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩ hnr
359	        | u =>
360	          cases m with
361	          | zero => rw [h0] at hp; cases hp
362	          | succ m' => exact absurd hp (h (m' + 1) (by omega) (by omega)).1
363	      simp only [hp]; exact ih'
364	
365	theorem startAt_congr {ψ' : Array R} (i : Nat) (h : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]! = ψ'[k]!) :
366	    startAt op ψ i = startAt op ψ' i := by
367	  induction i with
368	  | zero => simp only [startAt, startStep, h 0 (Nat.le_refl _)]
369	  | succ m ih =>
370	    simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
371	      h (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), h m (by omega), ih (fun k hk => h k (by omega))]
372	
373	end Start

376	-- The running state
377	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
378	section RunState
379	variable {times : Array Q} {rate : Array (Option Q)} {g : Q}
380	
381	theorem lastWide_any_iff (i j : Nat) :
382	    (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = true ↔
383	      ∃ k, j ≤ k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ k ≠ 0 ∧ Q.gt (dt times k) g = true := by
384	  induction i with
385	  | zero => simp [runAt, runStep, Run.init]; intro k _ hk h; omega
386	  | succ i ih =>
387	    simp only [runAt, runStep]
388	    by_cases hw : Q.gt (dt times (i + 1)) g = true
389	    · have hc : (i + 1 != 0 && Q.gt (dt times (i + 1)) g) = true := by simp [hw]
390	      rw [if_pos hc]
391	      simp only [Option.any_some, decide_eq_true_eq]
392	      constructor
393	      · intro h; exact ⟨i + 1, h, Nat.le_refl _, by omega, hw⟩
394	      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, _, _⟩; omega
395	    · simp only [hw, Bool.and_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
396	      rw [ih]
397	      constructor
398	      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩; exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3, h4⟩
399	      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
400	        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h2) with hk | hk
401	        · exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3, h4⟩
402	        · subst hk; exact absurd h4 hw
403	
404	theorem lastMissing_any_iff (i j : Nat) :
405	    (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = true ↔ ∃ k, j < k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ rate[k]! = none := by
406	  induction i with
407	  | zero =>
408	    simp only [runAt, runStep]
409	    cases hr : rate[0]! <;> simp [Run.init] <;> intro k h1 h2 <;> omega
410	  | succ i ih =>
411	    simp only [runAt, runStep]
412	    cases hr : rate[i + 1]! with
413	    | none =>
414	      simp only [Option.isNone_none, if_true, Option.any_some, decide_eq_true_eq]
415	      constructor
416	      · intro h; exact ⟨i + 1, h, Nat.le_refl _, hr⟩
417	      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, _⟩; omega
418	    | some ω =>
419	      simp only [Option.isNone_some, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
420	      rw [ih]
421	      constructor
422	      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩; exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3⟩
423	      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩
424	        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h2) with hk | hk
425	        · exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3⟩
426	        · subst hk; rw [hr] at h3; cases h3
427	
428	theorem integral_le (j i : Nat) (h : i ≤ j) : integral times rate j i = some 0 := by
429	  cases i with
430	  | zero => rfl
431	  | succ i => simp [integral, h]
432	
433	/-- With every rate of `(j, i]` present, the specification is the difference of the running sums. -/
434	theorem integral_eq_sum (j i : Nat) (hji : j ≤ i) (hr : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
435	    integral times rate j i = some ((runAt times rate g i).sum.val - (runAt times rate g j).sum.val) := by
436	  induction i with
437	  | zero =>
438	    have : j = 0 := by omega
439	    subst this; simp only [integral]; congr 1; grind
440	  | succ i ih =>
441	    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hji) with hlt | heq
442	    · have hj : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ j) := by omega
443	      have ih' := ih (by omega) (fun k h1 h2 => hr k h1 (by omega))
444	      obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (hr (i + 1) hlt (Nat.le_refl _))
445	      simp only [integral, hj, if_false, ih', hω, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def]
446	      simp only [runAt, runStep, hω, dt, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
447	      rw [Q.val_add, Q.val_mul, Q.val_sub]
448	      congr 1
449	      grind
450	    · subst heq; rw [integral_le _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)]; congr 1; grind
451	
452	theorem runAt_congr {times' : Array Q} {rate' : Array (Option Q)} (i : Nat)
453	    (ht : ∀ k, k ≤ i → times[k]! = times'[k]!) (hr : ∀ k, k ≤ i → rate[k]! = rate'[k]!) :
454	    runAt times rate g i = runAt times' rate' g i := by
455	  induction i with
456	  | zero => simp only [runAt, runStep, dt, hr 0 (Nat.le_refl _), if_true]
457	  | succ m ih =>
458	    simp only [runAt, runStep, dt, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
459	      hr (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), ht (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), ht m (by omega),
460	      ih (fun k hk => ht k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hr k (by omega))]
461	
462	end RunState

464	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
465	-- The theorems of the operator. `F` below is `sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ`.
466	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
467	section Operator
468	variable {times : Array Q} {rate : Array (Option Q)} {g : Q} {op : String} {missing : UnknownReason} {ψ : Array R}
469	
470	/-- T1: one value per observation. -/
471	theorem size_sinceRiseIntegralAll : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ).size = ψ.size := by
472	  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll; split <;> simp
473	
474	theorem get_pos (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) :
475	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! =
476	      match startAt op ψ i with
477	      | .error e => .error e
478	      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
479	      | .ok (some j) =>
480	        if (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) then .error (.samplingGap op)
481	        else if (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) then .error missing
482	        else .ok (Q.sub (runAt times rate g i).sum (runAt times rate g j).sum) := by
483	  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll
484	  rw [if_pos hg, getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa using hi)]
485	  simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_range, valueAt]
486	  rw [runStartAll_get op ψ i hi, runs_get times rate g _ i hi]
487	  cases hs : startAt op ψ i with
488	  | error e => rfl
489	  | ok o =>
490	    cases o with
491	    | none => rfl
492	    | some j =>
493	      simp only [runs_get times rate g _ j (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ((startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs).1 hi)]
494	
495	/-- Under a step bound that is not positive, every observation is unknown, malformed. -/
496	theorem not_positive (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = false) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) :
497	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.malformed s!"{op} step bound is not positive") := by
498	  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll
499	  rw [if_neg (by simp [hg]), getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa using hi)]
500	  simp
501	
502	private theorem gap_of_le {j i : Nat}
503	    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) :
504	    (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = false := by
505	  cases h : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) with
506	  | false => rfl
507	  | true =>
508	    obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := (lastWide_any_iff i j).mp h
509	    have := (Q.le_iff_not_gt _ _).mp (hgap k h1 h2)
510	    simp only [dt, h3, if_false] at h4
511	    rw [this] at h4; cases h4
512	
513	private theorem rate_of_some {j i : Nat} (hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
514	    (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = false := by
515	  cases h : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) with
516	  | false => rfl
517	  | true =>
518	    obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (lastMissing_any_iff i j).mp h
519	    have := hrate k h1 h2; rw [h3] at this; cases this
520	
521	/-- T4: at an observed start with a positive bound, intervals within the bound from the one ending
522	    at the start, and every rate since present, the value is decided and is the discrete sum. -/
523	theorem at_anchor (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
524	    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true)
525	    (hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
526	    ∃ q, (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok q ∧ integral times rate j i = some q.val := by
527	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
528	  simp only [gap_of_le hgap, rate_of_some hrate, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
529	  exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [integral_eq_sum j i ha.1 hrate, Q.val_sub]⟩
530	
531	/-- The value at a start whose bracket interval is within the bound is zero. -/
532	theorem zero_at_anchor (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (j : Nat) (hj : j < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j j)
533	    (hgap : Q.le (Q.sub times[j]! times[j - 1]!) g = true) :
534	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[j]! = .ok Q.zero := by
535	  rw [get_pos hg j hj, (startAt_some_iff j j).mpr ha]
536	  have hw := gap_of_le (times := times) (rate := rate) (j := j) (i := j)
537	    (fun k h1 h2 => by have : k = j := by omega
538	                       subst this; exact hgap)
539	  have hm := rate_of_some (times := times) (rate := rate) (g := g) (j := j) (i := j)
540	    (fun k h1 h2 => absurd h2 (by omega))
541	  simp only [hw, hm, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Q.sub_self]
542	
543	/-- T5: a decided value comes from a positive bound and an observed start, intervals within the
544	    bound from the one ending at the start, every rate since present, and is the discrete sum. -/
545	theorem decided_anchored (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (q : Q)
546	    (h : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok q) :
547	    Q.lt Q.zero g = true ∧ ∃ j, AnchorAt ψ j i ∧
548	      (∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) ∧
549	      (∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) ∧
550	      integral times rate j i = some q.val := by
551	  cases hg : Q.lt Q.zero g with
552	  | false => rw [not_positive hg i hi] at h; cases h
553	  | true =>
554	    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
555	    rw [get_pos hg i hi] at h
556	    cases hs : startAt op ψ i with
557	    | error e => simp only [hs] at h; cases h
558	    | ok o =>
559	      cases o with
560	      | none => simp only [hs] at h; cases h
561	      | some j =>
562	        simp only [hs] at h
563	        have ha := (startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs
564	        cases hw : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) with
565	        | true => simp [hw] at h
566	        | false =>
567	          cases hm : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) with
568	          | true => simp [hw, hm] at h
569	          | false =>
570	            simp only [hw, hm, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Except.ok.injEq] at h
571	            have hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true := by
572	              intro k h1 h2
573	              have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by have := ha.2.1.1; omega
574	              cases hgt : Q.gt (dt times k) g with
575	              | false => simp only [dt, hk0, if_false] at hgt; exact (Q.le_iff_not_gt _ _).mpr hgt
576	              | true =>
577	                have := (lastWide_any_iff (rate := rate) i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hk0, hgt⟩
578	                rw [hw] at this; cases this
579	            have hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome := by
580	              intro k h1 h2
581	              cases hr : rate[k]! with
582	              | some _ => rfl
583	              | none =>
584	                have := (lastMissing_any_iff (times := times) (g := g) i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hr⟩
585	                rw [hm] at this; cases this
586	            refine ⟨j, ha, hgap, hrate, ?_⟩
587	            rw [integral_eq_sum j i ha.1 hrate, ← h, Q.val_sub]
588	
589	/-- T6: ψ false at every observation so far: unknown, truncated. -/
590	theorem none_observed (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v = .f) :
591	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
592	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_none_iff i).mpr h]
593	
594	/-- T6: ψ true at the first observation and known with no definite rise since: unknown, truncated. -/
595	theorem onset_before_recording (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h0 : ψ[0]!.v = .t)
596	    (h : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k) :
597	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
598	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, startAt_truncated i h0 h]
599	
600	/-- T6: no observed start: unknown. -/
601	theorem no_anchor_unknown (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h : ¬ ∃ j, AnchorAt ψ j i) :
602	    ∃ e, (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error e := by
603	  cases hd : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! with
604	  | error e => exact ⟨e, rfl⟩
605	  | ok q => obtain ⟨_, j, ha, _⟩ := decided_anchored i hi q hd; exact absurd ⟨j, ha⟩ h
606	
607	/-- T7: an interval longer than the bound ending at an observation of `[j, i]`: a sampling gap. -/
608	theorem wide_interval (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
609	    (hk : ∃ k, j ≤ k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ Q.gt (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) :
610	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.samplingGap op) := by
611	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
612	  obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hk
613	  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by have := ha.2.1.1; omega
614	  have : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = true :=
615	    (lastWide_any_iff i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hk0, by simpa [dt, hk0] using h3⟩
616	  simp only [this, if_true]
617	
618	/-- T7: the bracket of the start (the interval ending at it) longer than the bound: a sampling gap. -/
619	theorem bracket_wide (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
620	    (hb : Q.gt (Q.sub times[j]! times[j - 1]!) g = true) :
621	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.samplingGap op) :=
622	  wide_interval hg i j hi ha ⟨j, Nat.le_refl _, ha.1, hb⟩
623	
624	/-- T7: a missing rate since the start, with every interval within the bound: `missing`. -/
625	theorem missing_rate (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
626	    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true)
627	    (hk : ∃ k, j < k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ rate[k]! = none) :
628	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error missing := by
629	  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
630	  have : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = true := (lastMissing_any_iff i j).mpr hk
631	  simp only [gap_of_le hgap, this, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]
632	
633	/-- T8: the value at `i` depends only on the times, rates and ψ at observations `≤ i`. -/
634	theorem causal {times' : Array Q} {rate' : Array (Option Q)} {ψ' : Array R} (i : Nat)
635	    (hi : i < ψ.size) (hi' : i < ψ'.size)
636	    (ht : ∀ k, k ≤ i → times[k]! = times'[k]!) (hr : ∀ k, k ≤ i → rate[k]! = rate'[k]!)
637	    (hψ : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]! = ψ'[k]!) :
638	    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = (sinceRiseIntegralAll times' rate' g op missing ψ')[i]! := by
639	  cases hg : Q.lt Q.zero g with
640	  | false => rw [not_positive hg i hi, not_positive hg i hi']
641	  | true =>
642	    rw [get_pos hg i hi, get_pos hg i hi', startAt_congr i hψ, runAt_congr i ht hr]
643	    cases hs : startAt op ψ' i with
644	    | error e => rfl
645	    | ok o =>
646	      cases o with
647	      | none => rfl
648	      | some j =>
649	        have hj : j ≤ i := ((startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs).1
650	        simp only [runAt_congr j (fun k hk => ht k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hr k (by omega))]
651	
652	/-- T9: the sum splits at any intermediate observation. -/
653	theorem integral_split (j m i : Nat) (hjm : j ≤ m) (hmi : m ≤ i) :
654	    integral times rate j i = (do let a ← integral times rate j m; let b ← integral times rate m i; pure (a + b)) := by
655	  induction i with
656	  | zero =>
657	    have h1 : m = 0 := by omega
658	    have h2 : j = 0 := by omega
659	    subst h1; subst h2; simp [integral, Rat.add_zero]
660	  | succ i ih =>
661	    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmi) with hlt | heq
662	    · have hj : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ j) := by omega
663	      have hm : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ m) := by omega
664	      simp only [integral, hj, hm, if_false, ih (by omega)]
665	      cases integral times rate j m <;> cases integral times rate m i <;> cases rate[i + 1]! <;>
666	        simp [Rat.add_assoc]
667	    · subst heq
668	      rw [integral_le _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)]
669	      cases integral times rate j (i + 1) <;> simp [Rat.add_zero]
670	
671	/-- T9: between two decided observations of one start, the sum is the difference of the values. -/
672	theorem accumulates (i i' j : Nat) (hi' : i' < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i') (hji : j ≤ i) (hii : i ≤ i')
673	    (a b : Q) (h1 : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok a)
674	    (h2 : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i']! = .ok b) :
675	    integral times rate i i' = some (b.val - a.val) := by
676	  obtain ⟨_, j₁, ha₁, _, _, hI₁⟩ := decided_anchored i (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hii hi') a h1
677	  obtain ⟨_, j₂, ha₂, _, _, hI₂⟩ := decided_anchored i' hi' b h2
678	  have e₁ : j₁ = j := by
679	    have := ((startAt_some_iff (op := op) i j₁).mpr ha₁).symm.trans ((startAt_some_iff i j).mpr (ha.mono hji hii))
680	    cases this; rfl
681	  have e₂ : j₂ = j := by
682	    have := ((startAt_some_iff (op := op) i' j₂).mpr ha₂).symm.trans ((startAt_some_iff i' j).mpr ha)
683	    cases this; rfl
684	  rw [e₁] at hI₁; rw [e₂] at hI₂
685	  have hs := integral_split (times := times) (rate := rate) j i i' hji hii
686	  rw [hI₂, hI₁] at hs
687	  cases hx : integral times rate i i' with
688	  | none => rw [hx] at hs; simp at hs
689	  | some x =>
690	    rw [hx] at hs
691	    simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def, Option.some.injEq] at hs
692	    congr 1; grind
693	
694	end Operator
695	
696	end Accumulate

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Accumulate
  A rate integrated since a condition last became true, over the whole trace in one forward pass,
  and its specification over Lean's `Rat`.

  The start at observation `i` is `Temporal.runStartAll`'s: the latest observation `j ≤ i` at which
  the condition rose definitely (false at `j − 1`, true at `j`), with the condition known at every
  observation of `(j, i]`. The value is Σ_{k ∈ (j, i]} rate_k · (t_k − t_{k−1}): zero at the start,
  the rate at an observation covering the interval that ends there. It is unknown, never a value,
  at every observation when the step bound is not positive; where the start is unknown or none is
  observed (`windowTruncated op`, or the condition's reason); where an interval ending at an
  observation of `[j, i]`, the one ending at the start included, is longer than the step bound
  (`samplingGap op`); where a rate of `(j, i]` is missing (`missing`).

  Proved here: the start is exactly the latest definite rise with the condition known since; a
  decided value comes from such a start, a positive bound, intervals within the bound, present rates,
  and equals the discrete sum; each unknown case gives its reason; the value at `i` depends only on
  the inputs at observations `≤ i`; the sum splits at any intermediate observation.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A rational's value in Lean's `Rat`. -/
def Q.val (q : Q) : Rat := mkRat q.num q.den

namespace Accumulate
open Temporal

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The operator
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The running state at an observation: the sum of rate × interval since the trace start (a
    missing rate adds nothing), the latest observation whose rate is missing, and the latest
    observation reached across an interval longer than the step bound. -/
structure Run where
  sum : Q
  lastMissing : Option Nat
  lastWide : Option Nat
  deriving Inhabited

def Run.init : Run := ⟨Q.zero, none, none⟩

/-- The interval ending at observation `i`; zero at the first. -/
def dt (times : Array Q) (i : Nat) : Q := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub times[i]! times[i - 1]!

/-- The state at observation `i` from the state at the observation before. -/
def runStep (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) (prev : Run) (i : Nat) : Run :=
  { sum := match rate[i]! with | some ω => Q.add prev.sum (Q.mul ω (dt times i)) | none => prev.sum
    lastMissing := if (rate[i]!).isNone then some i else prev.lastMissing
    lastWide := if i != 0 && Q.gt (dt times i) maxStep then some i else prev.lastWide }

/-- The state at each of the first `n` observations, in one forward pass. -/
def runs (n : Nat) (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) : Array Run :=
  (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Run) i =>
    acc.push (runStep times rate maxStep (if i = 0 then Run.init else acc[i - 1]!) i)) #[]

/-- The value at `i` from the starts and the states. -/
def valueAt (starts : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat))) (rs : Array Run) (op : String)
    (missing : UnknownReason) (i : Nat) : QR :=
  match starts[i]! with
  | .error e => .error e
  | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
  | .ok (some j) =>
    if (rs[i]!).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) then .error (.samplingGap op)
    else if (rs[i]!).lastMissing.any (j < ·) then .error missing
    else .ok (Q.sub (rs[i]!).sum (rs[j]!).sum)

/-- Rate × interval accumulated since ψ last became true, per observation. -/
def sinceRiseIntegralAll (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (maxStep : Q) (op : String)
    (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  if Q.lt Q.zero maxStep then
    (Array.range ψ.size).map (valueAt (runStartAll op ψ) (runs ψ.size times rate maxStep) op missing)
  else Array.replicate ψ.size (.error (.malformed s!"{op} step bound is not positive"))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The specification
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Σ_{k ∈ (j, i]} rate_k · (t_k − t_{k−1}) over `Rat`; none where a rate of `(j, i]` is missing;
    zero where `i ≤ j`. -/
def integral (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (j : Nat) : Nat → Option Rat
  | 0 => some 0
  | i + 1 => if i + 1 ≤ j then some 0 else do
      let acc ← integral times rate j i
      let ω ← rate[i + 1]!
      pure (acc + ω.val * ((times[i + 1]!).val - (times[i]!).val))

/-- ψ rises definitely at `j`: false at the observation before, true there. -/
def RisesAt (ψ : Array R) (j : Nat) : Prop := 0 < j ∧ ψ[j - 1]!.v = .f ∧ ψ[j]!.v = .t

/-- `j` is the start at `i`: a definite rise at `j ≤ i`, ψ known and rising nowhere in `(j, i]`. -/
def AnchorAt (ψ : Array R) (j i : Nat) : Prop :=
  j ≤ i ∧ RisesAt ψ j ∧ ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- `Q` in `Rat`
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section QVal

private theorem Q.ext' {a b : Q} (h₁ : a.num = b.num) (h₂ : a.den = b.den) : a = b := by
  cases a; cases b; simp_all

theorem Q.val_mk' (a : Int) (b : Nat) (hb : 0 < b) : (Q.mk' a b).val = mkRat a b := by
  unfold Q.mk' Q.val
  rw [dif_pos hb]
  simp only
  have hg : 0 < Nat.gcd a.natAbs b := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ hb
  have ha : ((Nat.gcd a.natAbs b : Nat) : Int) ∣ a := Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
  have hbd : Nat.gcd a.natAbs b ∣ b := Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
  generalize Nat.gcd a.natAbs b = G at hg ha hbd ⊢
  obtain ⟨a', rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨b', rfl⟩ := hbd
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by omega), Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg, Rat.mkRat_mul_left (Nat.ne_of_gt hg)]

private theorem den_ne (q : Q) : q.den ≠ 0 := Nat.ne_of_gt q.den_pos

theorem Q.val_add (a b : Q) : (Q.add a b).val = a.val + b.val := by
  unfold Q.add
  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
  unfold Q.val
  rw [Rat.mkRat_add_mkRat _ _ (den_ne a) (den_ne b)]

theorem Q.val_mul (a b : Q) : (Q.mul a b).val = a.val * b.val := by
  unfold Q.mul
  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
  unfold Q.val
  rw [Rat.mkRat_mul_mkRat]

theorem Q.val_sub (a b : Q) : (Q.sub a b).val = a.val - b.val := by
  unfold Q.sub
  rw [Q.val_mk' _ _ (Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos b.den_pos)]
  unfold Q.val
  rw [Rat.sub_eq_add_neg, Rat.neg_mkRat, Rat.mkRat_add_mkRat _ _ (den_ne a) (den_ne b), Int.neg_mul,
    ← Int.sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem Q.eq_iff_val (a b : Q) : Q.eq a b = true ↔ a.val = b.val := by
  unfold Q.eq Q.val
  rw [Rat.mkRat_eq_iff (den_ne a) (den_ne b)]
  simp

theorem Q.sub_self (a : Q) : Q.sub a a = Q.zero := by
  unfold Q.sub Q.mk'
  have hp : a.den * a.den > 0 := Nat.mul_pos a.den_pos a.den_pos
  rw [dif_pos hp]
  apply Q.ext' <;> simp [Q.zero, Q.ofInt, Int.sub_self, Nat.div_self hp]

theorem Q.le_iff_not_gt (a b : Q) : Q.le a b = true ↔ Q.gt a b = false := by
  unfold Q.le Q.gt Q.lt
  simp [Int.not_lt]

end QVal

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The passes, by observation
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Passes
variable (times : Array Q) (rate : Array (Option Q)) (g : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)

/-- One step of `runStartAll`, as its forward pass computes it. -/
def startStep (vals : Array R) (prev : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) (i : Nat) :
    Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
  match vals[i]!.v with
  | .t =>
    if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
    else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
      | .t => prev
      | .f => .ok (some i)
      | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
  | .f => prev
  | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))

/-- The state of `runStartAll` at observation `i`. -/
def startAt (vals : Array R) : Nat → Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)
  | 0 => startStep op vals (.ok none) 0
  | i + 1 => startStep op vals (startAt vals i) (i + 1)

/-- The running state at observation `i`. -/
def runAt : Nat → Run
  | 0 => runStep times rate g Run.init 0
  | i + 1 => runStep times rate g (runAt i) (i + 1)

/-- An array built by pushing, one observation at a time, a value that depends only on the values
    already pushed: its size, and each element as `v` gives it. -/
theorem build_get {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (f : Array α → Nat → α) (v : Nat → α) (N : Nat)
    (hf : ∀ acc i, i < N → acc.size = i → (∀ m, m < i → acc[m]! = v m) → f acc i = v i) :
    ∀ n, n ≤ N → ((List.range n).foldl (fun acc i => acc.push (f acc i)) #[]).size = n ∧
      ∀ k, k < n → ((List.range n).foldl (fun acc i => acc.push (f acc i)) #[])[k]! = v k := by
  intro n hn
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hs, hk⟩ := ih (by omega)
    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    refine ⟨by simp [hs], fun k hk' => ?_⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hk' with h | h
    · rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hs]; omega), Array.getElem_push_lt (by omega), ← getElem!_pos _ _ (by omega)]
      exact hk k h
    · subst h
      rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hs]), Array.getElem_push]
      simp only [hs, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false]
      exact hf _ _ (by omega) hs hk

theorem runs_get (n i : Nat) (hi : i < n) : (runs n times rate g)[i]! = runAt times rate g i := by
  unfold runs
  refine (build_get _ (runAt times rate g) n ?_ n (Nat.le_refl _)).2 i hi
  intro acc k _ hs hm
  cases k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k => simp only [Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]; rw [hm k (by omega)]; rfl

/-- A forward pass whose state is pushed at each observation, one value at a time: its size and each
    element as `v` gives it. -/
theorem pairs_get {β : Type} [Inhabited β] (s : β → Nat → β) (init : β) (v : Nat → β)
    (h0 : s init 0 = v 0) (hs : ∀ m, s (v m) (m + 1) = v (m + 1)) : ∀ n,
    ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).1.size = n ∧
    (∀ k, k < n → ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).1[k]! = v k) ∧
    (∀ m, n = m + 1 → ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).2 = v m) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨hsz, hk, h2⟩ := ih
    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    have hst : s ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array β × β) i => (acc.1.push (s acc.2 i), s acc.2 i)) (#[], init)).2 n = v n := by
      cases n with
      | zero => simpa using h0
      | succ m => rw [h2 m rfl]; exact hs m
    refine ⟨by simp [hsz], fun k hk' => ?_, fun m hm => by cases hm; exact hst⟩
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hk' with h | h
    · rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hsz]; omega), Array.getElem_push_lt (by omega), ← getElem!_pos _ _ (by omega)]
      exact hk k h
    · subst h
      rw [getElem!_pos _ _ (by simp [hsz]), Array.getElem_push]
      simp only [hsz, Nat.lt_irrefl, dite_false]
      exact hst

theorem runStartAll_get (vals : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < vals.size) :
    (runStartAll op vals)[i]! = startAt op vals i := by
  unfold runStartAll
  dsimp only
  rw [Array.mkEmpty_eq]
  exact (pairs_get (startStep op vals) (.ok none) (startAt op vals) rfl (fun _ => rfl) vals.size).2.1 i hi

end Passes

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The start
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Start
variable {op : String} {ψ : Array R}

theorem AnchorAt.mono {j i i' : Nat} (h : AnchorAt ψ j i') (hji : j ≤ i) (hii : i ≤ i') : AnchorAt ψ j i :=
  ⟨hji, h.2.1, fun k h1 h2 => h.2.2 k h1 (Nat.le_trans h2 hii)⟩

/-- T2: the start is `j` exactly where `j` is the latest definite rise with ψ known since. -/
theorem startAt_some_iff (i j : Nat) : startAt op ψ i = .ok (some j) ↔ AnchorAt ψ j i := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
      cases hv : ψ[0]!.v <;> simp [hv] at h
    | succ i ih =>
      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
      cases hv : ψ[i + 1]!.v <;> simp only [hv, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      · cases hp : ψ[i]!.v <;> simp only [hp] at h
        · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih h
          refine ⟨by omega, h2, fun k hk1 hk2 => ?_⟩
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk2) with hk | hk
          · exact h3 k hk1 (by omega)
          · subst hk; refine ⟨by simp [hv], fun ⟨_, hf, _⟩ => ?_⟩
            simp [hp] at hf
        · cases h
          exact ⟨Nat.le_refl _, ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩, fun k h1 h2 => absurd h2 (by omega)⟩
        · cases h
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih h
        refine ⟨by omega, h2, fun k hk1 hk2 => ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk2) with hk | hk
        · exact h3 k hk1 (by omega)
        · subst hk; exact ⟨by simp [hv], fun ⟨_, _, ht⟩ => by simp [hv] at ht⟩
      · cases h
  · intro ⟨hji, hr, hk⟩
    induction i with
    | zero => exact absurd hr.1 (by omega)
    | succ m ih =>
      rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hji) with hlt | heq
      · have ih' := ih (by omega) (fun k h1 h2 => hk k h1 (by omega))
        obtain ⟨hu, hnr⟩ := hk (m + 1) (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
        simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        cases hv : ψ[m + 1]!.v with
        | u => exact absurd hv hu
        | f => exact ih'
        | t =>
          have hp : ψ[m]!.v = .t := by
            cases hp : ψ[m]!.v with
            | t => rfl
            | f => exact absurd ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩ hnr
            | u =>
              rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hlt) with h | h
              · exact absurd hp (hk m h (by omega)).1
              · subst h; have := hr.2.2; rw [hp] at this; cases this
          simp only [hp]; exact ih'
      · subst heq
        obtain ⟨_, hf, ht⟩ := hr
        simp only [startAt, startStep, ht, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hf
        simp [hf]

/-- T3: no start observed exactly where ψ has been false at every observation so far. -/
theorem startAt_none_iff (i : Nat) : startAt op ψ i = .ok none ↔ ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v = .f := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction i with
    | zero =>
      intro k hk; have hk0 : k = 0 := by omega
      subst hk0
      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
      cases hv : ψ[0]!.v <;> simp [hv] at h ⊢
    | succ i ih =>
      simp only [startAt, startStep] at h
      cases hv : ψ[i + 1]!.v <;> simp only [hv, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h
      · cases hp : ψ[i]!.v <;> simp only [hp] at h
        · have := ih h i (Nat.le_refl _); rw [hp] at this; cases this
        · cases h
        · cases h
      · intro k hk
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk) with hk' | hk'
        · exact ih h k (by omega)
        · subst hk'; exact hv
      · cases h
  · intro h
    induction i with
    | zero => simp [startAt, startStep, h 0 (Nat.le_refl _)]
    | succ i ih =>
      simp only [startAt, startStep, h (i + 1) (Nat.le_refl _)]
      exact ih (fun k hk => h k (by omega))

/-- A run of true values reaching the first observation, with ψ known and rising nowhere since,
    leaves the start truncated: the onset may lie before the recording. -/
theorem startAt_truncated (i : Nat) (h0 : ψ[0]!.v = .t)
    (h : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k) :
    startAt op ψ i = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp [startAt, startStep, h0]
  | succ m ih =>
    have ih' := ih (fun k h1 h2 => h k h1 (by omega))
    obtain ⟨hu, hnr⟩ := h (m + 1) (by omega) (Nat.le_refl _)
    simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    cases hv : ψ[m + 1]!.v with
    | u => exact absurd hv hu
    | f => exact ih'
    | t =>
      have hp : ψ[m]!.v = .t := by
        cases hp : ψ[m]!.v with
        | t => rfl
        | f => exact absurd ⟨by omega, by simpa using hp, hv⟩ hnr
        | u =>
          cases m with
          | zero => rw [h0] at hp; cases hp
          | succ m' => exact absurd hp (h (m' + 1) (by omega) (by omega)).1
      simp only [hp]; exact ih'

theorem startAt_congr {ψ' : Array R} (i : Nat) (h : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]! = ψ'[k]!) :
    startAt op ψ i = startAt op ψ' i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp only [startAt, startStep, h 0 (Nat.le_refl _)]
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [startAt, startStep, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      h (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), h m (by omega), ih (fun k hk => h k (by omega))]

end Start

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The running state
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section RunState
variable {times : Array Q} {rate : Array (Option Q)} {g : Q}

theorem lastWide_any_iff (i j : Nat) :
    (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = true ↔
      ∃ k, j ≤ k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ k ≠ 0 ∧ Q.gt (dt times k) g = true := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp [runAt, runStep, Run.init]; intro k _ hk h; omega
  | succ i ih =>
    simp only [runAt, runStep]
    by_cases hw : Q.gt (dt times (i + 1)) g = true
    · have hc : (i + 1 != 0 && Q.gt (dt times (i + 1)) g) = true := by simp [hw]
      rw [if_pos hc]
      simp only [Option.any_some, decide_eq_true_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨i + 1, h, Nat.le_refl _, by omega, hw⟩
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, _, _⟩; omega
    · simp only [hw, Bool.and_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      rw [ih]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩; exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3, h4⟩
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h2) with hk | hk
        · exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3, h4⟩
        · subst hk; exact absurd h4 hw

theorem lastMissing_any_iff (i j : Nat) :
    (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = true ↔ ∃ k, j < k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ rate[k]! = none := by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    simp only [runAt, runStep]
    cases hr : rate[0]! <;> simp [Run.init] <;> intro k h1 h2 <;> omega
  | succ i ih =>
    simp only [runAt, runStep]
    cases hr : rate[i + 1]! with
    | none =>
      simp only [Option.isNone_none, if_true, Option.any_some, decide_eq_true_eq]
      constructor
      · intro h; exact ⟨i + 1, h, Nat.le_refl _, hr⟩
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, _⟩; omega
    | some ω =>
      simp only [Option.isNone_some, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      rw [ih]
      constructor
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩; exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3⟩
      · intro ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le h2) with hk | hk
        · exact ⟨k, h1, by omega, h3⟩
        · subst hk; rw [hr] at h3; cases h3

theorem integral_le (j i : Nat) (h : i ≤ j) : integral times rate j i = some 0 := by
  cases i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i => simp [integral, h]

/-- With every rate of `(j, i]` present, the specification is the difference of the running sums. -/
theorem integral_eq_sum (j i : Nat) (hji : j ≤ i) (hr : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
    integral times rate j i = some ((runAt times rate g i).sum.val - (runAt times rate g j).sum.val) := by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    have : j = 0 := by omega
    subst this; simp only [integral]; congr 1; grind
  | succ i ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hji) with hlt | heq
    · have hj : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ j) := by omega
      have ih' := ih (by omega) (fun k h1 h2 => hr k h1 (by omega))
      obtain ⟨ω, hω⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (hr (i + 1) hlt (Nat.le_refl _))
      simp only [integral, hj, if_false, ih', hω, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def]
      simp only [runAt, runStep, hω, dt, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      rw [Q.val_add, Q.val_mul, Q.val_sub]
      congr 1
      grind
    · subst heq; rw [integral_le _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)]; congr 1; grind

theorem runAt_congr {times' : Array Q} {rate' : Array (Option Q)} (i : Nat)
    (ht : ∀ k, k ≤ i → times[k]! = times'[k]!) (hr : ∀ k, k ≤ i → rate[k]! = rate'[k]!) :
    runAt times rate g i = runAt times' rate' g i := by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp only [runAt, runStep, dt, hr 0 (Nat.le_refl _), if_true]
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [runAt, runStep, dt, Nat.add_one_ne_zero, if_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
      hr (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), ht (m + 1) (Nat.le_refl _), ht m (by omega),
      ih (fun k hk => ht k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hr k (by omega))]

end RunState

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The theorems of the operator. `F` below is `sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ`.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Operator
variable {times : Array Q} {rate : Array (Option Q)} {g : Q} {op : String} {missing : UnknownReason} {ψ : Array R}

/-- T1: one value per observation. -/
theorem size_sinceRiseIntegralAll : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll; split <;> simp

theorem get_pos (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! =
      match startAt op ψ i with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
      | .ok (some j) =>
        if (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) then .error (.samplingGap op)
        else if (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) then .error missing
        else .ok (Q.sub (runAt times rate g i).sum (runAt times rate g j).sum) := by
  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll
  rw [if_pos hg, getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa using hi)]
  simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_range, valueAt]
  rw [runStartAll_get op ψ i hi, runs_get times rate g _ i hi]
  cases hs : startAt op ψ i with
  | error e => rfl
  | ok o =>
    cases o with
    | none => rfl
    | some j =>
      simp only [runs_get times rate g _ j (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ((startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs).1 hi)]

/-- Under a step bound that is not positive, every observation is unknown, malformed. -/
theorem not_positive (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = false) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.malformed s!"{op} step bound is not positive") := by
  unfold sinceRiseIntegralAll
  rw [if_neg (by simp [hg]), getElem!_pos _ _ (by simpa using hi)]
  simp

private theorem gap_of_le {j i : Nat}
    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) :
    (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = false := by
  cases h : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := (lastWide_any_iff i j).mp h
    have := (Q.le_iff_not_gt _ _).mp (hgap k h1 h2)
    simp only [dt, h3, if_false] at h4
    rw [this] at h4; cases h4

private theorem rate_of_some {j i : Nat} (hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
    (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = false := by
  cases h : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩ := (lastMissing_any_iff i j).mp h
    have := hrate k h1 h2; rw [h3] at this; cases this

/-- T4: at an observed start with a positive bound, intervals within the bound from the one ending
    at the start, and every rate since present, the value is decided and is the discrete sum. -/
theorem at_anchor (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true)
    (hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) :
    ∃ q, (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok q ∧ integral times rate j i = some q.val := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
  simp only [gap_of_le hgap, rate_of_some hrate, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [integral_eq_sum j i ha.1 hrate, Q.val_sub]⟩

/-- The value at a start whose bracket interval is within the bound is zero. -/
theorem zero_at_anchor (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (j : Nat) (hj : j < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j j)
    (hgap : Q.le (Q.sub times[j]! times[j - 1]!) g = true) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[j]! = .ok Q.zero := by
  rw [get_pos hg j hj, (startAt_some_iff j j).mpr ha]
  have hw := gap_of_le (times := times) (rate := rate) (j := j) (i := j)
    (fun k h1 h2 => by have : k = j := by omega
                       subst this; exact hgap)
  have hm := rate_of_some (times := times) (rate := rate) (g := g) (j := j) (i := j)
    (fun k h1 h2 => absurd h2 (by omega))
  simp only [hw, hm, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Q.sub_self]

/-- T5: a decided value comes from a positive bound and an observed start, intervals within the
    bound from the one ending at the start, every rate since present, and is the discrete sum. -/
theorem decided_anchored (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (q : Q)
    (h : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok q) :
    Q.lt Q.zero g = true ∧ ∃ j, AnchorAt ψ j i ∧
      (∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) ∧
      (∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome) ∧
      integral times rate j i = some q.val := by
  cases hg : Q.lt Q.zero g with
  | false => rw [not_positive hg i hi] at h; cases h
  | true =>
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [get_pos hg i hi] at h
    cases hs : startAt op ψ i with
    | error e => simp only [hs] at h; cases h
    | ok o =>
      cases o with
      | none => simp only [hs] at h; cases h
      | some j =>
        simp only [hs] at h
        have ha := (startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs
        cases hw : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) with
        | true => simp [hw] at h
        | false =>
          cases hm : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) with
          | true => simp [hw, hm] at h
          | false =>
            simp only [hw, hm, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Except.ok.injEq] at h
            have hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true := by
              intro k h1 h2
              have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by have := ha.2.1.1; omega
              cases hgt : Q.gt (dt times k) g with
              | false => simp only [dt, hk0, if_false] at hgt; exact (Q.le_iff_not_gt _ _).mpr hgt
              | true =>
                have := (lastWide_any_iff (rate := rate) i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hk0, hgt⟩
                rw [hw] at this; cases this
            have hrate : ∀ k, j < k → k ≤ i → (rate[k]!).isSome := by
              intro k h1 h2
              cases hr : rate[k]! with
              | some _ => rfl
              | none =>
                have := (lastMissing_any_iff (times := times) (g := g) i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hr⟩
                rw [hm] at this; cases this
            refine ⟨j, ha, hgap, hrate, ?_⟩
            rw [integral_eq_sum j i ha.1 hrate, ← h, Q.val_sub]

/-- T6: ψ false at every observation so far: unknown, truncated. -/
theorem none_observed (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v = .f) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_none_iff i).mpr h]

/-- T6: ψ true at the first observation and known with no definite rise since: unknown, truncated. -/
theorem onset_before_recording (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h0 : ψ[0]!.v = .t)
    (h : ∀ k, 0 < k → k ≤ i → ψ[k]!.v ≠ .u ∧ ¬ RisesAt ψ k) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.windowTruncated op) := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, startAt_truncated i h0 h]

/-- T6: no observed start: unknown. -/
theorem no_anchor_unknown (i : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (h : ¬ ∃ j, AnchorAt ψ j i) :
    ∃ e, (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error e := by
  cases hd : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! with
  | error e => exact ⟨e, rfl⟩
  | ok q => obtain ⟨_, j, ha, _⟩ := decided_anchored i hi q hd; exact absurd ⟨j, ha⟩ h

/-- T7: an interval longer than the bound ending at an observation of `[j, i]`: a sampling gap. -/
theorem wide_interval (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
    (hk : ∃ k, j ≤ k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ Q.gt (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.samplingGap op) := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
  obtain ⟨k, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hk
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by have := ha.2.1.1; omega
  have : (runAt times rate g i).lastWide.any (j ≤ ·) = true :=
    (lastWide_any_iff i j).mpr ⟨k, h1, h2, hk0, by simpa [dt, hk0] using h3⟩
  simp only [this, if_true]

/-- T7: the bracket of the start (the interval ending at it) longer than the bound: a sampling gap. -/
theorem bracket_wide (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
    (hb : Q.gt (Q.sub times[j]! times[j - 1]!) g = true) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error (.samplingGap op) :=
  wide_interval hg i j hi ha ⟨j, Nat.le_refl _, ha.1, hb⟩

/-- T7: a missing rate since the start, with every interval within the bound: `missing`. -/
theorem missing_rate (hg : Q.lt Q.zero g = true) (i j : Nat) (hi : i < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i)
    (hgap : ∀ k, j ≤ k → k ≤ i → Q.le (Q.sub times[k]! times[k - 1]!) g = true)
    (hk : ∃ k, j < k ∧ k ≤ i ∧ rate[k]! = none) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .error missing := by
  rw [get_pos hg i hi, (startAt_some_iff i j).mpr ha]
  have : (runAt times rate g i).lastMissing.any (j < ·) = true := (lastMissing_any_iff i j).mpr hk
  simp only [gap_of_le hgap, this, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]

/-- T8: the value at `i` depends only on the times, rates and ψ at observations `≤ i`. -/
theorem causal {times' : Array Q} {rate' : Array (Option Q)} {ψ' : Array R} (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < ψ.size) (hi' : i < ψ'.size)
    (ht : ∀ k, k ≤ i → times[k]! = times'[k]!) (hr : ∀ k, k ≤ i → rate[k]! = rate'[k]!)
    (hψ : ∀ k, k ≤ i → ψ[k]! = ψ'[k]!) :
    (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = (sinceRiseIntegralAll times' rate' g op missing ψ')[i]! := by
  cases hg : Q.lt Q.zero g with
  | false => rw [not_positive hg i hi, not_positive hg i hi']
  | true =>
    rw [get_pos hg i hi, get_pos hg i hi', startAt_congr i hψ, runAt_congr i ht hr]
    cases hs : startAt op ψ' i with
    | error e => rfl
    | ok o =>
      cases o with
      | none => rfl
      | some j =>
        have hj : j ≤ i := ((startAt_some_iff i j).mp hs).1
        simp only [runAt_congr j (fun k hk => ht k (by omega)) (fun k hk => hr k (by omega))]

/-- T9: the sum splits at any intermediate observation. -/
theorem integral_split (j m i : Nat) (hjm : j ≤ m) (hmi : m ≤ i) :
    integral times rate j i = (do let a ← integral times rate j m; let b ← integral times rate m i; pure (a + b)) := by
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    have h1 : m = 0 := by omega
    have h2 : j = 0 := by omega
    subst h1; subst h2; simp [integral, Rat.add_zero]
  | succ i ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hmi) with hlt | heq
    · have hj : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ j) := by omega
      have hm : ¬ (i + 1 ≤ m) := by omega
      simp only [integral, hj, hm, if_false, ih (by omega)]
      cases integral times rate j m <;> cases integral times rate m i <;> cases rate[i + 1]! <;>
        simp [Rat.add_assoc]
    · subst heq
      rw [integral_le _ _ (Nat.le_refl _)]
      cases integral times rate j (i + 1) <;> simp [Rat.add_zero]

/-- T9: between two decided observations of one start, the sum is the difference of the values. -/
theorem accumulates (i i' j : Nat) (hi' : i' < ψ.size) (ha : AnchorAt ψ j i') (hji : j ≤ i) (hii : i ≤ i')
    (a b : Q) (h1 : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i]! = .ok a)
    (h2 : (sinceRiseIntegralAll times rate g op missing ψ)[i']! = .ok b) :
    integral times rate i i' = some (b.val - a.val) := by
  obtain ⟨_, j₁, ha₁, _, _, hI₁⟩ := decided_anchored i (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hii hi') a h1
  obtain ⟨_, j₂, ha₂, _, _, hI₂⟩ := decided_anchored i' hi' b h2
  have e₁ : j₁ = j := by
    have := ((startAt_some_iff (op := op) i j₁).mpr ha₁).symm.trans ((startAt_some_iff i j).mpr (ha.mono hji hii))
    cases this; rfl
  have e₂ : j₂ = j := by
    have := ((startAt_some_iff (op := op) i' j₂).mpr ha₂).symm.trans ((startAt_some_iff i' j).mpr ha)
    cases this; rfl
  rw [e₁] at hI₁; rw [e₂] at hI₂
  have hs := integral_split (times := times) (rate := rate) j i i' hji hii
  rw [hI₂, hI₁] at hs
  cases hx : integral times rate i i' with
  | none => rw [hx] at hs; simp at hs
  | some x =>
    rw [hx] at hs
    simp only [Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_some, Option.pure_def, Option.some.injEq] at hs
    congr 1; grind

end Operator

end Accumulate
