-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Measured atoms by name (quantity-valued), on one scene. Vector atoms take a component literal.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def comp (v : Option Vec) (k : DArg) (name : String) : QR := do
  match k with
  | .s "x" => q (v.map (·.1)) name
  | .s "y" => q (v.map (·.2)) name
  | _ => .error (.malformed "component")

def evalMeasure (s : Scene) (name : String) (args : List DArg) : QR := do
  match name, args with
  | "kin_time", [] => .ok (Time.ofTimestamp (kin_time s))
  | "kin_position", [x, k] => comp (kin_position s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_heading", [x, k] => comp ((kin_heading s (← ent x)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "kin_velocity", [x, k] => comp (kin_velocity s (← ent x)) k name
  | "kin_speed", [x] => q (kin_speed s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_accel_longitudinal", [x] => q (kin_accel_longitudinal s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_yaw_rate", [x] => q (kin_yaw_rate s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_extent", [x, k] =>
    let e := kin_extent s (← ent x)
    match k with   -- full extents: twice the half-extent
    | .s "length" => q (e.map fun (l, _, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) l) name
    | .s "width" => q (e.map fun (_, w, _) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) w) name
    | .s "height" => q (e.map fun (_, _, h) => Q.mul (Q.ofInt 2) h) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "extent")
  | "kin_steer_angle", [x] => q (kin_steer_angle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_path_length", [x] => q (kin_path_length s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_gear", [x] => qz (kin_gear s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_throttle", [x] => q (kin_throttle s (← ent x)) name
  | "kin_service_brake", [x] => q (kin_service_brake s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_occupant_count", [x] => qn (ru_occupant_count s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls", [x] => qn (ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls s (← ent x)) name
  | "ru_electric_bicycle_class", [x] => qn (ru_electric_bicycle_class s (← ent x)) name
  | "st_lane_direction", [r, k] => comp ((st_lane_direction s (← ent r)).bind Geom.unit) k name
  | "st_lane_adjacency", [r, k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "ordinal" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
    | .s "count" => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "adjacency field")
  | "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_ordinal s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_adjacency_count", [r] => qn (st_lane_adjacency_count s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_lane_width", [r] => q (st_lane_width s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_curvature", [r] => q (st_curvature s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_grade", [r] => q (st_grade s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_distance", [r] => q (st_sight_distance s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_sight_along_way", [x, w] => q (st_sight_along_way s (← ent x) (← ent w)) name
  | "st_parking_space_angle", [r] => q (st_parking_space_angle s (← ent r)) name
  | "st_region_geometry", [r, k] => comp (st_region_geometry_position s (← ent r)) k name
  | "st_region_geometry_distance", [x, r] => q (st_region_geometry_distance s (← ent x) (← ent r)) name
  | "dev_position", [d, k] => comp (dev_position s (← ent d)) k name
  | "dev_speed_limit_sign_value", [d] => q (dev_speed_limit_sign_value s (← ent d)) name
  | "env_visibility", [] => q (env_visibility s) name
  | "env_civil_time", [k] =>
    let ct := env_civil_time s
    match k with
    | .s "minute_of_day" => qn (ct.map (·.minuteOfDay)) name
    | .s "weekday" => qn (ct.map (·.weekday)) name
    | .s "month" => qn (ct.map (·.month)) name
    | .s "day" => qn (ct.map (·.day)) name
    | .s "year" => qn (ct.map (·.year)) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "civil time field")
  | "rel_centre_distance", [a, a'] => q (rel_centre_distance s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_surface_gap", [a, a'] => q (rel_surface_gap_distance s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_surface_gap", [a, a', k] =>
    match k with
    | .s "longitudinal" => q (rel_surface_gap_longitudinal s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
    | .s "lateral" => q (rel_surface_gap_lateral s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
    | _ => .error (.malformed "gap component")
  | "rel_longitudinal_overlap", [a, a'] => q (rel_longitudinal_overlap s (← ent a) (← ent a')) name
  | "rel_bearing", [a, a', k] => comp (rel_bearing s (← ent a) (← ent a')) k name
  | n, _ => if measureNames.contains n then .error (arity n) else .error (unknownAtom n)
where
  measureNames : List String := [
    "kin_time", "kin_position", "kin_heading", "kin_velocity", "kin_speed", "kin_accel_longitudinal",
    "kin_yaw_rate", "kin_extent", "kin_steer_angle", "kin_path_length", "kin_gear", "kin_throttle", "kin_service_brake", "ru_occupant_count",
    "ru_rider_posture_hands_on_controls", "ru_electric_bicycle_class", "st_lane_direction", "st_lane_adjacency",
    "st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", "st_lane_adjacency_count", "st_lane_width", "st_curvature", "st_grade",
    "st_sight_distance", "st_sight_along_way", "st_parking_space_angle", "st_region_geometry", "st_region_geometry_distance",
    "dev_position", "dev_speed_limit_sign_value", "env_visibility", "env_civil_time",
    "rel_centre_distance", "rel_surface_gap", "rel_longitudinal_overlap", "rel_bearing"]

/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
    | _ => false
  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
  match name with
  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
  | n =>
    if !knowsAtom n then none
    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]
    else none

/-- The Lean name of an ATOMS.md id or attribute path (`dev.traffic_signal.shows` ↦ `dev_traffic_signal_shows`). -/
def defName (id : String) : String := id.replace "." "_"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The evaluator: every subformula once, over the whole trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constU n w
def liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR)) : Array QR :=
  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constE n w
def qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : Array QR :=
  Array.zipWith (fun x y => do pure (f (← x) (← y))) a b

/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
  | _ => false

/-- The single value of a constant term's per-instant array. -/
def constOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q := do
  if !Term.isConstant t then throw (.malformed "parameter is not a constant term")
  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

/-- The value of a heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, read as `constOf`
    reads a constant; any other term is malformed. -/
def stepOf (t : Term) (arr : Array QR) : Except UnknownReason Q :=
  match t with
  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)
  | _ => .error (.malformed "heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter")

/-- The subject variable of a window: needed for path windows, irrelevant for time windows. -/
def subjectFor (β : Binding) (m : Measure) (v : String) : Except UnknownReason TrackId :=
  match m with
  | .time => .ok 0
  | .path => match β.track v with | some t => .ok t | none => .error (.unboundVariable v)

/-- Every region a quantifier over a kind ranges over in some scene of the trace: those whose
    membership of the kind is not false there (`regionCandidates`). -/
def regionsOf (c : SemCtx) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => regionCandidates s k).eraseDups
def devicesOf (c : SemCtx) (k : DeviceKind) : List DeviceId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap fun s => deviceCandidates s k).eraseDups
/-- At each instant, whether the region is of the kind: true, false, or unknown where the source
    cannot tell the kind. A quantifier conjoins it with its body, so a region the source cannot
    place in the kind makes the quantifier unknown, never decided by its absence. -/
def regionIsKind (c : SemCtx) (r : RegionId) (k : StructureKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (isKind s r k) (.absentAtom s!"st_{k}")
def deviceIsKind (c : SemCtx) (d : DeviceId) (k : DeviceKind) : Array R :=
  c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (devKind s d k) (.absentAtom s!"dev_{k}")
/-- Every road user present in some scene of the trace. -/
def usersOf (c : SemCtx) : List TrackId :=
  (c.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups

/-- The kind a quantifier ranges over: a spelling of the ontology. A variable here is a concept's
    literal formal that no expansion filled. -/
def regionKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason StructureKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match StructureKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"region kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"region kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "region kind")
def deviceKindOf (a : Arg) : Except UnknownReason DeviceKind :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => match DeviceKind.ofString s with | some k => .ok k | none => .error (.malformed s!"device kind {s}")
  | .var v => .error (.malformed s!"device kind `{v}` is a variable")
  | .nat _ => .error (.malformed "device kind")

/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
    it is unknown. -/
def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
  match pre.v with
  | .t => x
  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
  match g.v with
  | .t => a
  | .f => b
  | .u => match a, b with
    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
  | none =>
    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
    match op with
    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
    | _ => do
      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
      else
        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
        match op with
        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!

/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
  | some true => R.t
  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
  | some false =>
    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
    | some false => R.f
    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
    let s := c.scenes[i]!
    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)

mutual
  def evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : Term → Array QR
    | .lit v _ => Array.replicate c.n (.ok v)
    | .param p => Array.replicate c.n (match c.d.ρ.param p with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.parameterMissing p))
    | .measure a args =>
      match resolveAll c.β args with
      | .error w => constE c.n w
      | .ok ds => c.scenes.map fun s => evalMeasure s a ds
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      liftQ c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalQ concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      match c.β.track subj with
      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
      | some x => Primitives.distanceWhile c.d x (evalAll c φ)
    | .sinceRise φ => sinceRiseAll c.d.times (evalAll c φ)
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      match c.β.track subj with
      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
      | some x => liftQ c.n do
          let gv ← stepOf g (evalTAll c g)
          pure (Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ))
    | .aggregate op v φ t =>
      let members := (usersOf c).map fun u =>
        let c' := c.bindVar v (.track u)
        (u, evalAll c' φ, evalTAll c' t)
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
        let s := c.scenes[i]!
        aggregateAt op (members.filterMap fun (u, fa, ta) => if s.tracks.contains u then some (fa[i]!, ta[i]!) else none)
    | .add a b' => qzip Q.add (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .sub a b' => qzip Q.sub (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .mul a b' => qzip Q.mul (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .div a b' => Array.zipWith (fun x y => do
        let d ← y
        if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
    | .cond φ a b' =>
      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
    | [] => .ok []
    | t :: rest => do
      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts

  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
    | .tt => const c.n R.t
    | .ff => const c.n R.f
    | .atom name args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
          pure (match ds with
            | [.v t, .s id] =>
              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
              | none =>
                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
    | .intent id who target =>
      match who, target with
      | .var a, .var b =>
        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
    | .same a b =>
      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
    | .and φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .or φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .implies φ ψ =>
      let a := evalAll c φ
      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .within m d subj φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      liftA c.n do
        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
        | .error w => R.u w
        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      liftA c.n do
        let vs ← constParams c ps
        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
    | .rule id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .ruleApplies id map =>
      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
    | .existsUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
    | .forallUser v φ =>
      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      match regionKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      match deviceKindOf k with
      | .error w => constU c.n w
      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
end

/-- The value of a formula at instant `i`. -/
def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every formula and every term has exactly one value per observation of the trace.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

private theorem n_bindVar (c : SemCtx) (v : String) (x : Val) : (c.bindVar v x).n = c.n := rfl
private theorem size_constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constU n w).size = n := by
  simp [constU, Temporal.size_const]
private theorem size_constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : (constE n w).size = n := by simp [constE]
private theorem size_liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R))
    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftA n e).size = n := by
  unfold liftA; cases e with
  | ok a => exact h a rfl
  | error w => exact size_constU n w
private theorem size_liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR))
    (h : ∀ a, e = .ok a → a.size = n) : (liftQ n e).size = n := by
  unfold liftQ; cases e with
  | ok a => exact h a rfl
  | error w => exact size_constE n w
private theorem size_qzip (f : Q → Q → Q) (a b : Array QR) : (qzip f a b).size = min a.size b.size := by
  simp [qzip]
private theorem size_perScene (c : SemCtx) (ev : List (Nat × Array R)) (p : Scene → Nat → Bool)
    (agg : List R → R) : (perScene c ev p agg).size = c.n := by simp [perScene]

mutual
  theorem size_evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ t : Term, (evalTAll c t).size = c.n
    | .lit _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .param _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .measure _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; split <;> simp [size_constE, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .quantity _ args ps => by
        rw [evalTAll]; apply size_liftQ; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        exact Primitives.size_evalQ _ _ _ _ _ h
    | .distanceWhile s φ => by
        rw [evalTAll]; split
        · exact size_constE _ _
        · rw [Primitives.size_distanceWhile]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .sinceRise φ => by rw [evalTAll, Temporal.size_sinceRiseAll]; exact size_evalAll c φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => by
        rw [evalTAll]; split
        · exact size_constE _ _
        · apply size_liftQ; intro a h
          cases hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) <;> simp only [hg, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure] at h <;>
            try contradiction
          cases h; rw [Primitives.size_headingSince]; exact size_evalAll c ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
    | .add a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .sub a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .mul a b => by rw [evalTAll, size_qzip, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .div a b => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c a, size_evalTAll c b, Nat.min_self]
    | .neg a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
    | .abs a => by rw [evalTAll, Array.size_map]; exact size_evalTAll c a
    | .cond _ _ _ => by rw [evalTAll]; simp
  termination_by t => sizeOf t

  theorem size_evalAll (c : SemCtx) : ∀ φ : Formula, (evalAll c φ).size = c.n
    | .tt => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
    | .ff => by rw [evalAll]; exact Temporal.size_const _ _
    | .atom name args ps => by
        rw [evalAll]; apply size_liftA; intro a h
        cases hv : constParams c ps <;> cases hr : resolveAll c.β args <;>
          simp only [hv, hr, bind, Except.bind] at h <;> try contradiction
        split at h
        · cases h; split
          · split
            · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
            · split
              · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
              · simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
          · exact Temporal.size_const _ _
        · cases h; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .cmp l _ r => by rw [evalAll, Array.size_zipWith, size_evalTAll c l, size_evalTAll c r, Nat.min_self]
    | .asm _ => by rw [evalAll]; simp [SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .intent _ who target => by
        cases who <;> cases target <;> rw [evalAll] <;> (repeat' split) <;>
          simp [size_constU, SemCtx.n, SemCtx.scenes, Primitives.Ctx.n]
    | .same a b => by

section Lemmas
variable (c : SemCtx) (φ ψ : Formula)

theorem evalAll_tt : evalAll c .tt = const c.n R.t := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_ff : evalAll c .ff = const c.n R.f := by rw [evalAll]
theorem evalAll_not : evalAll c (.not φ) = (evalAll c φ).map R.not := by rw [evalAll]; rfl
private theorem and_of_f (a b : R) (h : a.v = .f) : R.and a b = R.f := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.and, R.settle, Tri.and, R.f]
private theorem or_of_t (a b : R) (h : a.v = .t) : R.or a b = R.t := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.or, R.settle, Tri.or, R.t]
private theorem implies_of_f (a b : R) (h : a.v = .f) : R.implies a b = R.t := by
  rcases a with ⟨av, aw⟩; subst h; simp [R.implies, R.not, R.or, R.settle, Tri.not, Tri.or, R.t]

/-- A connective is the pointwise three-valued operation of its operands' arrays, whether or not
    its right operand was evaluated: where the left one settles it at every instant, both arrays
    have one value per observation and every pointwise value is the settled one. -/
theorem evalAll_and : evalAll c (.and φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.and (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2

  · rfl

  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]
      rw [or_of_t _ _ (by simpa using h i (by simpa using h1))]
  · rfl
theorem evalAll_implies : evalAll c (.implies φ ψ) = Array.zipWith R.implies (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalAll]; split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Array.all_eq_true] at h
    apply Array.ext
    · simp [size_evalAll]
    · intro i h1 h2
      simp only [Array.getElem_map, Array.getElem_zipWith]

theorem evalAll_rule (id : String) (map : List (String × String)) (h : (c.compose id map c.β false).size = c.n) :

    evalAll c (.ruleApplies id map) = c.compose id map c.β true := by rw [evalAll]; simp [h]

theorem evalTAll_headingSince (s : String) (g : Term) (x : TrackId) (gv : Q)
    (hx : c.β.track s = some x) (hg : stepOf g (evalTAll c g) = .ok gv) :
    evalTAll c (.headingSince s g ψ) = Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ) := by
  rw [evalTAll]; simp only [hx, hg, liftQ, bind, Except.bind, pure, Except.pure]

  unfold eval at *
  rw [evalAll_not, Array.getElem?_map]
  simp only [Array.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, R.not_v] at *
  rw [h]; rfl

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
  What a specification is: binders with class formulas, an applicability and an obligation, and
  the declarations a reviewer needs (parameters, assumptions, declared intentions,
  operationalizations, residues, narrowings, the rules it composes, the surrogate flag).

  A residue is a span of the text the rule does not capture at all; the plan declares it and the
  rule repeats it verbatim. A narrowing is a reading the coder chose on a span the plan does
  carry, stated here so the review judges the rule as it is: the span it names and why. The
  coder may add narrowings and never residues.

  Applicability and obligation are two formulas because a rule whose situation never arises is
  not compliant, it is not engaged: `notApplicable` is a verdict of its own, the witness check can
  demand a scenario for it, and a monitor reads the applicability as the trigger and the
  obligation as what to verify once triggered.

  A surrogate rule (the whole duty is an operationalized standard) is monitored like any other,
  but its verdicts are evidence about the standard, never the law's own verdict; the flag is what
  the monitor and the export propagate so the two are never summed.

  This file holds the declarations only and imports no evaluator: a rule file that imports it
  can state a rule but cannot read a scene, evaluate a formula or build evidence. Evaluation and
  the static check are in RuleEval.lean, which nothing under Rules/ may import.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A binder: a variable and the class formula (over `ru_*` atoms and class-level derived
    concepts) a track must satisfy to be bound to it. The subject comes first. -/
structure Binder where
  name : String
  cls : Formula
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A reading chosen on a span the record carries, declared where it is made: the span (a
    segmentation id for a rule, a run of the contract's words for a concept) and what the formulas
    state more narrowly than the words. `kind` is `reading` where the words leave the choice open,
    `observable_reading` where a word with no observable counterpart is read through the conduct
    or the feature it refers to, `no_atom` or `no_operator` where the vocabulary or the language
    cannot state the words — a declaration the gate returns for a gap, never a reading the rule
    stands on. -/
structure Narrowing where
  span : String
  why : String
  kind : String := "reading"
  deriving Repr, Inhabited, DecidableEq

structure Rule where
  id : String                                   -- the node id, derived from the law id
  laws : List String                            -- the corpus ids this rule formalizes
  binders : List Binder
  applicability : Formula
  obligation : Formula
  assumptions : List AsmId := []
  intentions : List IntId := []                 -- the declared intentions its formulas read
  operationalizations : List Operationalization := []
  residues : List String := []                  -- what the text says and the rule does not capture
  narrowings : List Narrowing := []             -- readings the coder chose on carried spans
  surrogate : Bool := false
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

inductive Verdict
  | violated
  | compliant
  | notApplicable
  | unknown (why : List UnknownReason)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
  Metric windows without a frame rate.

  Every observation carries a timestamp; a body also carries the path length it has travelled.
  A window is measured in one of the two: a duration of time, or a length of path travelled.
  Semantics are defined on the OBSERVED instants only; the one interpolation-free precondition is
  adequacy: a window of length d over a span is adequate when consecutive observations in the
  span are at most d/2 apart. An inadequate span yields `unknown`
  with the reason `samplingGap`, never a verdict invented between frames.

  Windows are computed for every instant of a trace at once: positions are monotone, so the
  window boundary moves one way and a two-pointer sweep with a range-maximum table over the gaps
  gives every window in O(n log n).

  There is no `next`, no rate and no frame count anywhere in the library.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Units

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- Milliseconds, monotone within a trace. -/
abbrev Timestamp := Int

/-- Which quantity a window is measured in. -/
inductive Measure
  | time | path
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited

/-- A window: a non-negative length in seconds (time) or metres (path). -/
structure Duration where

5	  timestamp: no law, rule, formula, contract or reading parameter. Every check is exact, in

13	    highway, and an `entrance_of` entry names a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or

246	      ++ (match kin_heading s x with
247	       | some h => if Q.isZero h.1 && Q.isZero h.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} heading is the zero vector"] else []
248	       | none => [])
249	
250	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
251	-- Occupancy, path length, heading against yaw rate
252	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
253	/-- The trace with the occupancy of every observed track derived from the geometry: in each scene,
254	    for a track in `occupancy_observed` whose footprint is defined, `occupies` holds the pair
255	    (track, structure) exactly when the footprint and the structure's valid boundary overlap as
256	    closed sets; what the trace listed for that track is replaced, every other pair kept. -/
257	def completeOccupancy (τ : Trace) : Trace :=
258	  τ.map fun s =>
259	    let derived := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups.filter (footprint s · |>.isSome)
260	    let kept := s.occupies.filter fun (t, _) => !derived.contains t
261	    let made := derived.flatMap fun t => match footprint s t with
262	      | none => []
263	      | some fp => s.structures.filterMap fun st => match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
264	        | some poly => if (boundaryErrors poly).isEmpty && Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some (t, st.id) else none
265	        | none => none
266	    { s with occupies := kept ++ made }
267	
268	private def occupancy (s : Scene) : List String :=
269	  let obs := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups
270	  if obs.isEmpty then []
271	  else
272	    let bodies := obs.filterMap fun t =>
273	      if (footprint s t).isNone then
274	        some s!"{at_ s}: track {t} is in occupancy_observed but lacks a position, a non-zero heading or an extent, so its footprint is undefined"
275	      else none
276	    let unbounded := s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
277	      if (st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id).isNone then
278	        some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} has no boundary; where occupancy is observed every structure needs one, since a pair left out of occupies is read as not occupied"
279	      else none
280	    bodies ++ unbounded
281	
282	private def pathLength (τ : Trace) : List String :=
283	  let tracks := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
284	  tracks.flatMap fun x =>
285	    let obs := τ.filterMap fun s => (kin_path_length s x).map fun p => (s, p, kin_position s x)
286	    (obs.zip (obs.drop 1)).flatMap fun ((s0, p0, q0), (s1, p1, q1)) =>
287	      let inc := Q.sub p1 p0
288	      if Q.lt inc Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length {qs p1} is less than {qs p0} at t={s0.t}; it never decreases"]
289	      else match q0, q1 with
290	        | some a, some b =>
291	          if Q.lt (Q.mul inc inc) (Geom.normSq (Geom.vsub b a)) then
292	            [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length grows by {qs inc} m since t={s0.t}, less than the straight-line distance between its two positions"]
293	          else []
294	        | _, _ => []
295	
296	/-- Whether two non-zero headings are the same direction: parallel and not opposed. -/
297	def sameDirection (a b : Vec) : Bool := Q.isZero (Geom.cross a b) && Q.gt (Geom.dot a b) Q.zero
298	
299	/-- Whether an angle in degrees is a whole number of turns. -/
300	def wholeTurns (deg : Q) : Bool := deg.num % (360 * (deg.den : Int)) == 0
301	
302	private def yaw (τ : Trace) : List String :=
303	  (τ.zip (τ.drop 1)).flatMap fun (s0, s1) =>
304	    s1.tracks.filterMap fun x =>
305	      match kin_heading s0 x, kin_heading s1 x, kin_yaw_rate s1 x with
306	      | some h0, some h1, some ω =>
307	        if !sameDirection h0 h1 then none
308	        else
309	          let turn := Q.mul ω (Q.sub (Time.ofTimestamp s1.t) (Time.ofTimestamp s0.t))
310	          if wholeTurns turn then none
311	          else some s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} keeps the heading it had at t={s0.t}, but its yaw rate turns it {qs turn}° over the interval (the rate at a scene is held over the interval before it)"
312	      | _, _, _ => none
313	
314	/-- The identity and reference defects of a trace: what no adapter output can contain, whoever
315	    wrote it. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
316	def checkReferences (τ : Trace) : List String :=
317	  τ.flatMap identity ++ links τ
318	
319	/-- Every inconsistency of a written trace. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
320	def checkTrace (τ : Trace) : List String :=
321	  checkReferences τ ++ staticMap τ ++ devices τ ++ representation τ ++ geometry τ
322	    ++ τ.flatMap occupancy ++ pathLength τ ++ yaw τ
323	
324	/-- Every defect of the witness instant: `at` is a scene's timestamp, and every grounded track and
325	    every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene. -/
326	def checkWitness (τ : Trace) (grounding : List (String × TrackId)) (entities : List (String × Val)) (at_ms : Timestamp) : List String :=
327	  match τ.find? (·.t == at_ms) with
328	  | none => [s!"at {at_ms} is not the timestamp of any scene"]
329	  | some s =>
330	    (grounding.filterMap fun (b, t) =>
331	      if s.tracks.contains t then none else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: binder {b} is grounded to track {t}, which is not in this scene")
332	    ++ entities.filterMap fun (n, v) =>
333	      if present s v.kind (match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d) then none
334	      else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: entity {n} is {kindName v.kind} {match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d}, which is not in this scene"
335	
336	end TraceLint
337	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.TraceLint
  The admission check of a trace written by hand (a reviewer's counterexample), before any rule is
  run on it. It reads the trace and, for the witness check, a grounding, a case's entities and one
  timestamp: no law, rule, formula, contract or reading parameter. Every check is exact, in
  rational arithmetic, with no tolerance: a written trace has no measurement noise, and its author
  is shown these rules. Traces a source records are never held to it.

  `checkTrace` requires:
  - identity: track, region and device ids unique within a scene; at most one measured relation
    per ordered pair of tracks within a scene; every reference a scene makes (`Scene.references`)
    names an entity of that kind present in the same scene, a sight-along-way entry names a
    highway, and an `entrance_of` entry names a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or
    path, or a kind refining one (`StructureKind.entranceCarriers`); every track a link names
    appears in some scene;
  - a static map: the same structures in every scene, each identical at every appearance; every
    device that does not move (`Device.mobile`) in every scene; a device identical at every
    appearance outside its state (`Device.staticPart`);
  - one representation of direction and control: a designated direction (`lane.direction`) is
    carried only by a structure a vehicle travels in (`directionKinds`: a lane, reserved lane,
    turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder; a centre turn lane
    carries none), and is not the zero vector; each carrier stands on its own, and carriers that
    overlap or cross may carry different directions. A device whose control is observed governs
    only the travel regions whose traffic it controls, or an intersection, read as control of the
    junction itself (`governedKinds`); never a highway, a controlled-access region or a region no
    vehicle travels in. Only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind
    refining one, carries the intersection it is an approach to (`lane.enters_intersection`); a
    roadway, one-way roadway, shoulder or bicycle lane or path that carries one is a directed
    approach segment entering that one intersection, which the check cannot see, and a whole
    two-way roadway or bicycle path carries none. Only a stop line or a crosswalk
    lists the carriers whose entrance it marks (`entrance_of`). A place no carrier covers has no
    designated direction, a device whose `governs` is not written has no observed control, and a
    line whose `entrance_of` is not written has no observed entrances; none is filled in;
  - valid geometry: a boundary has at least three vertices, all distinct (the first is not
    repeated at the end), a non-zero area and no self-intersection; an extent's half-length and
    half-width are positive; a path length is not negative; a heading is not the zero vector; a
    supplied relation's `surface_gap` has no negative component (each is a distance between the
    bodies' nearest points, zero on contact or overlap);
  - geometric occupancy: a track whose occupancy is observed has a position, a heading and an
    extent, and in a scene with such a track every structure has a valid boundary, because a
    pair absent from `occupies` is read as not occupied. The pairs of such a track are not
    written by hand: `completeOccupancy` derives them, the pair (track, structure) exactly when
    the track's footprint (`footprint`) and the structure's boundary overlap as closed sets
    (`Geom.polygonsOverlap`), so touching counts and a body on the line between two lanes
    occupies both;
  - path length: between consecutive observations of a track's path length it never decreases,
    and its increase is at least the straight-line distance between the two positions;
  - heading against yaw rate: where a track's heading is the same direction at two consecutive
    scenes (parallel and not opposed, whatever the vectors' lengths), the yaw rate integrated
    between them, ω (t₁ − t₀) with the later sample's rate held over the interval before it, is a
    whole number of turns (a multiple of 360°).
  `checkReferences` is the identity part alone. A witness trace is held to the whole check, after
  `completeOccupancy`, as a reviewer's trace is.
  `checkWitness` requires that `at` is the timestamp of a scene, and that every grounded track and
  every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene.

  Each message names the scene by its timestamp, the entity and the field.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace TraceLint

private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
private def kindName : EntityKind → String
  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
  match ks.reverse with
  | [] => ""
  | [k] => k.toString
  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"

/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
  match k with
  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
  | .device => (s.device id).isSome

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity and references
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.devices.map (·.id))).map (fun d => s!"{at_ s}: device id {d} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.relations.map fun m => (m.a, m.b))).map (fun (a, b) => s!"{at_ s}: more than one relation for the ordered pair ({a}, {b})")
  ++ s.references.filterMap fun r =>
    if !present s r.kind r.id then
      some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names {kindName r.kind} {r.id}, which is not in this scene"
    else if r.structureKinds.isEmpty then none
    else if (s.structure? r.id).map (fun st => r.structureKinds.any (st.kind.refines ·)) == some true then none
    else some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names region {r.id}, which is not a {orList r.structureKinds}"

private def links (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let all := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  τ.flatMap fun s => s.links.flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    ([a, b].filter (!all.contains ·)).map fun t => s!"{at_ s}: links names track {t}, which appears in no scene"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The static map and the devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def staticMap (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  match τ with
  | [] => []
  | s0 :: _ =>
    let ids0 := s0.structures.map (·.id)
    let first := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? (·.structure? r)
    τ.flatMap fun s =>
      let ids := s.structures.map (·.id)
      (ids0.filter (!ids.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is missing; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ (ids.filter (!ids0.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is not in the first scene; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ s.structures.filterMap fun st => match first st.id with
        | some st0 => if reprStr st0 != reprStr st then some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} differs from its first appearance; every field of a structure is the same in every scene" else none
        | none => none

private def devices (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let ids := (τ.flatMap fun s => s.devices.map (·.id)).eraseDups
  let first := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? (·.device d)
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (ids.filterMap fun d => match first d with
      | some dv => if !dv.mobile && (s.device d).isNone then some s!"{at_ s}: device {d} is missing; a device that does not move is in every scene" else none
      | none => none)
    ++ s.devices.filterMap fun dv => match first dv.id with
      | some d0 =>
        if reprStr d0.staticPart != reprStr dv.staticPart then
          some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} differs from its first appearance in a field that is not its state (its state is {String.intercalate ", " Device.stateFields}{if d0.mobile then ", position" else ""})"
        else none
      | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Representation: where a designated direction and a device's control are written
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The structure kinds a vehicle travels in that may carry a designated direction. A centre turn
    lane, shared by both directions, carries none. -/
def directionKinds : List StructureKind :=
  [.lane, .reservedLane, .turnLane, .bicycleLaneOrPath, .roadway, .oneWayRoadway, .shoulder]

/-- The structure kinds a device may govern: the kinds refining the travel region, the regions
    whose traffic it controls and an intersection, read as control of the junction itself and of
    nothing else. -/
def governedKinds : List StructureKind :=
  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => !k.isAbstract && k.refines .travelRegion

/-- The structure kinds that mark a carrier's entrance into an intersection. -/
def entranceKinds : List StructureKind := [.stopLine, .crosswalk]

/-- The structure kinds that carry an entrance into an intersection: those of
    `StructureKind.entranceCarriers` and every kind refining one of them. -/
def carrierKinds : List StructureKind :=
  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => StructureKind.entranceCarriers.any (k.refines ·)

/-- The kinds a region may have at each region argument of an atom or primitive, keyed by its Lean
    name and the argument's index in its full argument list: `some ks` where the field the name reads
    there is carried by, or may name, only a region whose kind is in `ks` (the lists this check and
    `Scene.references` hold the field to); `none` where a region of any kind may stand there. A class
    atom `st_<kind>` reads the label every region has and is `none`. -/
def regionArgKinds : List ((String × Nat) × Option (List StructureKind)) :=
  let refining := fun (ks : List StructureKind) => StructureKind.all.filter fun k => ks.any (k.refines ·)
  [(("st_lane_enters", 0), some carrierKinds),
   (("st_entrance_of", 0), some entranceKinds),
   (("st_entrance_of", 1), some (refining StructureKind.entranceCarriers)),
   (("st_lane_direction", 0), some directionKinds),
   (("dev_governs", 1), some governedKinds),
   (("st_sight_along_way", 1), some (refining StructureKind.sightWays)),
   (("prim_region_offset_along", 2), some directionKinds)]
  ++ ([("st_lane_enters", 1), ("rel_occupies", 1), ("st_road_edge_paved", 0), ("st_shoulder_paved", 0),
       ("st_median_or_divider_opening", 0), ("st_crosswalk_marked", 0), ("st_reserved_lane_class", 0),
       ("st_turn_lane_side", 0), ("st_parking_space_designation", 0), ("st_curb_zone_kind", 0),
       ("st_curb_zone_colour", 0), ("st_obstruction_kind", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 2),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 1), ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 0),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 1), ("st_lane_connectivity", 0), ("st_lane_connectivity", 1), ("st_on_way", 0),
       ("st_on_way", 1), ("st_lane_marking", 0), ("st_lane_marking_left", 0), ("st_lane_marking_right", 0),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_count", 0), ("st_lane_width", 0), ("st_curvature", 0),
       ("st_grade", 0), ("st_sight_distance", 0), ("st_parking_space_angle", 0), ("st_region_geometry", 0),
       ("st_region_geometry_distance", 1), ("prim_region_lateral_offset", 1), ("prim_region_offset_along", 1)]
      ++ StructureKind.all.map fun k => (s!"st_{k}", 0)).map (·, none)

private def representation (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let firstStructure := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s.t
  let firstDevice := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.device d).map fun _ => s.t
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
      -- the map is static, so each structure is reported once, at its first appearance
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t then []
      else match st.lane.bind (·.direction) with
        | none => []
        | some v =>
          (if directionKinds.contains st.kind then []
           else [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.direction; only a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder does"])
          ++ (if Q.isZero v.1 && Q.isZero v.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} lane.direction is the zero vector"] else []))
    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || (st.lane.bind (·.entersIntersection)).isNone || carrierKinds.contains st.kind then none
      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.enters_intersection; only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind refining one, enters an intersection as an approach")
    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || !st.entranceObserved || entranceKinds.contains st.kind then none
      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries entrance_of; only a stop line or a crosswalk marks an entrance")
    ++ s.devices.flatMap fun dv =>
      if firstDevice dv.id != some s.t || !dv.governsObserved then []
      else dv.governs.filterMap fun r => match s.structure? r with
        | some st =>
          if governedKinds.contains st.kind then none
          else some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} governs structure {r} ({st.kind.toString}); a device governs the travel regions whose traffic it controls (a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, centre turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder) or an intersection"
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- What is wrong with a boundary, or nothing. -/
def boundaryErrors (poly : List Vec) : List String :=
  if poly.length < 3 then ["has fewer than three vertices"]
  else if !(dups poly).isEmpty then ["repeats a vertex (the first vertex is not repeated at the end)"]
  else if Q.isZero (Geom.area2 poly) then ["has zero area"]
  else if Geom.selfIntersects poly then ["intersects itself"]
  else []

private def geometry (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let firstOf := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      -- a structure is static, so its boundary is reported once, at its first appearance
      if (firstOf st.id).map (·.t) != some s.t then none
      else match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
        | some poly => match boundaryErrors poly with
          | [] => none
          | e :: _ => some s!"{at_ s}: the boundary of structure {st.id} {e}"
        | none => none)
    ++ (s.relations.filterMap fun m => match m.surfaceGap with
      | some (lon, lat) =>
        if Q.lt lon Q.zero || Q.lt lat Q.zero then
          some s!"{at_ s}: relation ({m.a}, {m.b}) surface_gap ({qs lon}, {qs lat}) has a negative component; each component is a distance between the bodies' nearest points, along and across a's heading, zero on contact or overlap"
        else none
      | none => none)
    ++ s.tracks.flatMap fun x =>
      (match kin_extent s x with
       | some (l, w, _) => if Q.le l Q.zero || Q.le w Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} extent: the half-length and the half-width must be positive"] else []
       | none => [])
      ++ (match kin_path_length s x with
       | some p => if Q.lt p Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} path_length {qs p} is negative"] else []
       | none => [])
      ++ (match kin_heading s x with
       | some h => if Q.isZero h.1 && Q.isZero h.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} heading is the zero vector"] else []
       | none => [])

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy, path length, heading against yaw rate
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The trace with the occupancy of every observed track derived from the geometry: in each scene,
    for a track in `occupancy_observed` whose footprint is defined, `occupies` holds the pair
    (track, structure) exactly when the footprint and the structure's valid boundary overlap as
    closed sets; what the trace listed for that track is replaced, every other pair kept. -/
def completeOccupancy (τ : Trace) : Trace :=
  τ.map fun s =>
    let derived := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups.filter (footprint s · |>.isSome)
    let kept := s.occupies.filter fun (t, _) => !derived.contains t
    let made := derived.flatMap fun t => match footprint s t with
      | none => []
      | some fp => s.structures.filterMap fun st => match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
        | some poly => if (boundaryErrors poly).isEmpty && Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some (t, st.id) else none
        | none => none
    { s with occupies := kept ++ made }

private def occupancy (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let obs := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups
  if obs.isEmpty then []
  else
    let bodies := obs.filterMap fun t =>
      if (footprint s t).isNone then
        some s!"{at_ s}: track {t} is in occupancy_observed but lacks a position, a non-zero heading or an extent, so its footprint is undefined"
      else none
    let unbounded := s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if (st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id).isNone then
        some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} has no boundary; where occupancy is observed every structure needs one, since a pair left out of occupies is read as not occupied"
      else none
    bodies ++ unbounded

private def pathLength (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let tracks := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  tracks.flatMap fun x =>
    let obs := τ.filterMap fun s => (kin_path_length s x).map fun p => (s, p, kin_position s x)
    (obs.zip (obs.drop 1)).flatMap fun ((s0, p0, q0), (s1, p1, q1)) =>
      let inc := Q.sub p1 p0
      if Q.lt inc Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length {qs p1} is less than {qs p0} at t={s0.t}; it never decreases"]
      else match q0, q1 with
        | some a, some b =>
          if Q.lt (Q.mul inc inc) (Geom.normSq (Geom.vsub b a)) then
            [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length grows by {qs inc} m since t={s0.t}, less than the straight-line distance between its two positions"]
          else []
        | _, _ => []

/-- Whether two non-zero headings are the same direction: parallel and not opposed. -/
def sameDirection (a b : Vec) : Bool := Q.isZero (Geom.cross a b) && Q.gt (Geom.dot a b) Q.zero

/-- Whether an angle in degrees is a whole number of turns. -/
def wholeTurns (deg : Q) : Bool := deg.num % (360 * (deg.den : Int)) == 0

private def yaw (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  (τ.zip (τ.drop 1)).flatMap fun (s0, s1) =>
    s1.tracks.filterMap fun x =>
      match kin_heading s0 x, kin_heading s1 x, kin_yaw_rate s1 x with
      | some h0, some h1, some ω =>
        if !sameDirection h0 h1 then none
        else
          let turn := Q.mul ω (Q.sub (Time.ofTimestamp s1.t) (Time.ofTimestamp s0.t))
          if wholeTurns turn then none
          else some s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} keeps the heading it had at t={s0.t}, but its yaw rate turns it {qs turn}° over the interval (the rate at a scene is held over the interval before it)"
      | _, _, _ => none

/-- The identity and reference defects of a trace: what no adapter output can contain, whoever
    wrote it. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
def checkReferences (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap identity ++ links τ

/-- Every inconsistency of a written trace. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
def checkTrace (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  checkReferences τ ++ staticMap τ ++ devices τ ++ representation τ ++ geometry τ
    ++ τ.flatMap occupancy ++ pathLength τ ++ yaw τ

```lean

def headingChange : Term := .headingSince "u" pHeadingStep onset
def body : Formula := .cmp headingChange .ge pTurnAngle
```

Element by element, over the formals and the one claimed atom only:

  `kin.yaw_rate` is signed, left positive, so "to the left … above the onset yaw rate" is the plain
  strict comparison of the signed rate with the parameter. `Term.headingSince` counts from the
  definite rise of this formula, which is the observed onset.
- *"the heading change accumulated since that onset"* → `headingChange`: the same atom integrated
  by the language's own construct since that onset, counted from zero there, with the heading step
  as the step bound (the declared time formal used directly, as required).
- *"reaches at least the turn angle … to the left"* → the body: `≥ turn_angle`, inclusive.

`headingSince`'s own semantics: the comparison becomes true at the observation at which the
accumulated change first reaches the angle, stays true at later observations while it still holds it
(a later rate of zero adds nothing), restarts at the next definite onset, and is **unknown, never
false**, where no onset is observed with the onset formula known at every observation since (a turn
already under way at the first observation, or an unknown rate that could hide the onset), where an
interval from the one ending at the onset is wider than the heading step, or where a rate since the
onset is missing.

Positions follow the headings at 5 m an observation. |
| 2 | `OK` | — |

   **latest** definite rise of `kin.yaw_rate > onset_yaw_rate` before the judged observation, not the
   first of the recording. The contract's own later words — *"until a later onset starts the count
   again"* — direct this, and it is what `Term.headingSince` takes as its start.

   inclusively (`.ge`); both are dictated by the words, so neither is declared as a narrowing.
3. **Witness figures** (the witness's own, not the concept's): heading step 500 ms = the spacing of
   the observations, onset yaw rate 5 deg/s, turn angle 45 deg; one car, ten observations half a
   second apart, no region and no device, since the concept states the turning of the body only.

The gate returned `OK` on the second run: the two files build, the body passes the static checks and

`unknown` (the last for the masked atom alone) on built scenes. Nothing in the record is wrong — the
contract's extent and history clauses map onto `Term.headingSince` without approximation — so there
is no defect to report and no reason to spend further runs.
